title: Fitting a line to pointing trials
description: You can connect fitted coefficients to the plotted prediction formula.

steps.description: You select two data columns as ID and MT. polyfit with degree one returns the slope b_hat and intercept a_hat, which the next statements format for display.
The plot places trial markers at the observed ID and MT values. You build xs across the observed ID range for the fitted line.

steps.question: Does the fitted line use a new fit for each xs value?
steps.answer: No. Every prediction uses the same coefficients in a_hat + b_hat * xs.

steps.description: You add the fitted line, axis labels, title and legend before show. The supplied text output reports the fitted coefficients and reciprocal-slope throughput.
